quest.Name: The Great Egg-Hunt Begins
quest.Accomplishment: By request of Ditzy-Fly, I am tasked with finding as many of their lost kin as I can and return them to her. My reward will be entry to their city.
quest.Hagiograph: =name= scoured the lands, hunting eggs in the name of the anesheym and their great shah.

step.Name: Find egglings to deliver to the Anesheym
step.text: Scour the lands of Qud in search of the lost children of the Anesheym, a sacred bug-folk hidden in the region known as Bevidd.

step.Name: Egg'sellent Hunting Skills
step.text: You found enough eggs to impress the Speakers of Rhemhez'Qen! You have been granted access to the city. Ditzy says you should head down and speak to the Grand Shah.

quest.Name: The Shah, and the City that Waits Upon the Long Sigh
quest.Accomplishment: You received a gift from the shah of Rhemhex'Qen, but also learned there seemed to be more the shah needed. A strange corrupting presence is seeping its way into the region. The Shah has asked you to speak with Saile, in the the maintenance hub west of shah's oasis to help in discovering its source.

step.Name: Speak with the Saile
step.text: Return to Rhemhex'Qen and speak with the Saile on the west wing of the third floor.

step.Name: Enter the Long Sigh
step.text: A displacer, south, on the third floor of Rhemhex'Qen. Will bring you to the Long Sigh, there

quest.Name: The Red-Bear's Request
quest.Accomplishment: Saile, a barathrumite separated from their kind, has asked you to bring them scrap and bits in order to repair Rhemhex'Qen's failing infrastructure.

step.Name: Get Those Bits
step.text: Find bits and scrap to give to Saile!
